mainEntity.name: Why does administrative decision process matter at the approval stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because expectations stay healthier when outcomes are described honestly, with the real limits created by documents, timing, and authority discretion. Before the next step, administrative decision process usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does conditions of approval matter at the approval stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because immigration matters do not end at approval, because status maintenance, registrations, updates, and later duties can shape what happens next. Before the next step, conditions of approval usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does registration obligations matter at the approval stage?
